summary.title: Proj Arch: connecting students to real scholars.
summary.description: Proj Arch is a startup I’m building with my collaborator to connect K-14 students with verified scholars and their research. We’re making complex ideas easier to understand through grade-aware explanations, evidence-based reading activities, and pathways to scholars who reflect students’ backgrounds and communities. Our goal is to build a new American education model for reading comprehension with the help of AI.

page.description: Proj Arch brings scholar discovery, AI-assisted explanations, reading practice, and learning communities into one platform. From young readers to adult learners, the aim is to make academic expertise easier to find, understand, and use.

mission.title: Make academic knowledge part of everyday learning.
mission.description: Finding a scholar is only the beginning. Learners need a way to understand unfamiliar ideas, connect them to their own interests, and practice reasoning. Proj Arch brings discovery, explanation, and participation together so that research can become a starting point for learning at every level.
mission.goal: Build a new American education model for reading comprehension with the help of AI.

product.title: From the first question to a deeper understanding.

features.label: Scholar directory
features.title: Find the person behind the work.
features.description: Explore academic profiles through fields of study, institutions, and backgrounds. A profile brings together a scholar’s research focus, work, milestones, and publications, giving learners a starting point for understanding their expertise.

features.label: Veri AI
features.title: Explore expertise at your level.
features.description: Veri AI is the platform’s domain-specialized AI layer. Ask about a scholar or an idea, then adapt the explanation by age, grade, language, and learning depth, from a first introduction to a more advanced discussion.

features.label: Young readers
features.title: Build comprehension through practice.
features.description: Reading warm-ups combine riddles, passage puzzles, story prompts, vocabulary, and inference questions. Learners practice noticing clues, making predictions, and supporting an answer with evidence. Streaks and badges are part of the proposed experience.

features.label: Scholar knowledge hubs
features.title: Keep the conversation and resources together.
features.description: A scholar’s hub connects AI-assisted conversation with course materials, podcasts, course videos, and groups. Summarize an answer, request a different explanation, or translate it to keep exploring in a way that works for you.

features.label: Learning communities
features.title: Learn through shared questions.
features.description: Discover research circles, interest groups, and labs through scholar details. Open and closed groups provide spaces to share updates, discuss papers, comment on ideas, and organize course materials, meetings, and resources.

features.label: Adult Hub
features.title: Continue learning beyond the classroom.
features.description: An adult-focused space brings profiles, courses, community news, and social updates together. It gives learners a place to explore academic interests and follow conversations across research, professional learning, and community life.

features.label: AI-assisted discovery
features.title: Start with a topic that interests you.
features.description: Describe what you want to explore in your own words. The search experience is designed to bring together relevant scholars, courses, labs, podcasts, and community resources so a question can lead to several useful paths.

features.label: Schools and learning platforms
features.title: Adapt the experience to your learners.
features.description: The Veri AI concept includes customization for schools and other platforms. Explanations by age and grade, multiple languages, and adjustable learning depth help shape the experience around different learners and educational settings.

audience.title: Different learners. A shared connection to knowledge.

items.title: Young readers and students

items.title: Educators and schools

items.title: Adult learners

items.title: Scholars and research communities
items.description: Bring research, publications, teaching resources, and discussions together so visitors can understand the work and find ways to keep learning.

closing.title: Explore the work behind the idea.
